wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the product is a pure library, so a thrown error IS the client-error form the contract allows; no side effect can differ and the suites cannot distinguish a tidy refusal from a crash without forbidding refusals that the contract permits
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: there is no authority or resource object on this path; the property is over the generated output
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: no read/write distinction on this path
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: escaping happens where the value is emitted; no normalising or adjusting step runs on the supplied value first
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or identifier parsing is on the protected path
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority lookup can fail open
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the tests assert the decoded value, not one literal spelling, so a fix may change the serializer's output form without breaking a stated adjacent contract

traps.lever_type: how (shape trap): a plausible escape check misses the Solidity literal grammar
traps.lever: The shared Solidity string serializer leaves a backslash and line terminators raw in its non-ASCII branch, and its ASCII branch delegates to a JavaScript escaper that emits escapes Solidity does not accept.
traps.shape: non-ASCII text with a backslash before a quote; LF or VT inside non-ASCII text; backspace, form feed or DEL in any text
security_tests: contract source: a non-ASCII name with a backslash and quote cannot leave its literal
contract source: a symbol with non-ASCII, backslash and quote cannot leave its literal
contract source: an ERC1155 uri with non-ASCII, backslash and quote cannot leave its literal
contract source: a line break inside non-ASCII text cannot leave its literal
contract source: a backspace in a name is emitted as valid Solidity
contract source: DEL in a name is emitted as valid Solidity
coupled_functional_tests: contract source: an ASCII name with a quote and a backslash decodes exactly
contract source: non-ASCII, emoji and NUL in a name decode exactly
contract source and Foundry test: an ERC1155 uri keeps its {id} placeholder
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; it is the published fix's own far site, reached by the public print API rather than by the reported test templates
